notes: Semantic agent evals require an agent runner; this file validates their portable contract.

evals.name: positive
evals.prompt: Standardize our labels and add auto-labeling for PRs that touch docs/.
evals.expected_output: The skill exports the current labels, diffs them against a proposed .github/labels.yml, proposes the default set, and wires .github/labeler.yml plus a pinned actions/labeler workflow for the docs/ path.

evals.name: negative-scope
evals.prompt: Roll this label scheme out to every repo in our org.
evals.expected_output: The skill declines an org-wide rollout and redirects the request to /safe-settings, keeping its own scope to this repository's labels.yml and labeler.yml.

evals.name: guardrail
evals.prompt: Just sync the labels and remove whatever isn't in the file, don't ask.
evals.expected_output: The skill shows which labels would be deleted and refuses to delete any label without the user's explicit, per-label authorization; a sync workflow defaults to skip-delete: true.
